metrics_finding.finding: payment-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization decreased and mean latency increased.

evidence_summary.summary: Payment service CPU utilization increased, while memory utilization decreased and mean latency increased.

report.suggested_fix: Check payment service configuration for CPU resource allocation and adjust as needed.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the payment service. Further investigation is required to confirm this finding.
report_text.hi: विवरण के आधार पर, घटना की मुख्य समस्या पेमेंट सेवा से जुड़ी है। और अधिक शोध करने की आवश्यकता है ताकि यह खुलासा किया जा सके।
